connector.name: SeedBase Test Data
connector.registryDescription: Generate realistic, FK-consistent synthetic test data for your databases from your AI assistant.
connector.summary: Hosted at seedba.se over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package client. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the marcelglaeser account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <SEEDBASE_API_KEY> — create the API key at https://seedba.se -> Settings -> API keys
